name: Mornington Main Beach
signature: Colourful bathing boxes, calm bay water, and a village esplanade that makes Mornington one of the Peninsula's most appealing base towns
editorNote:
Mornington Main Beach is iconic for a reason — the row of brightly painted bathing boxes along the foreshore is one of the most photographed scenes on the Peninsula, and the beach itself delivers easy bay swimming with the town right behind it.

The Mornington SLSC is one of the Peninsula's most active clubs, patrolling through summer. The esplanade cafes and the short walk up into the village make this the most complete 'arrive, swim, eat, explore' beach on the bay side.

Good for all ages. The bathing boxes are privately owned and some are available for holiday hire — a genuinely different Peninsula stay. Come early on a summer morning when the light hits the boxes and the bay is still.
whyWeGo: The bathing boxes, the bay, the town behind it — Mornington Main Beach is the Peninsula in a single frame.
ifOnlyOneThing: Get here early morning — the bathing boxes in morning light are worth the alarm.
